name: FlagEmbedding
statusSub: Tier 1 passed; independent cold reproduction passed
summary: A one-step FlagEmbedding fine-tune adapted an existing compact BERT checkpoint on ten public NLI examples and produced a public safetensors checkpoint. Strict Clean-DAG verification passes 14/14, the AI-BOM scores 100/100, and an independent cold reproduction completed 1/1 steps with the recorded checkpoint regenerated byte-for-byte. This is checkpoint adaptation, not training a model from scratch.
experimentUrlNote: The selected upstream fine-tune recipe explicitly disables external reporting with WANDB_MODE=disabled, and the recorded invocation follows that path with --report_to none; adding a separate logger would change the captured workload.

truncation.note: The recorded run stopped after one optimizer step, equal to 0.1 epoch over the selected ten-example NLI file. Upstream's standard encoder example specifies two epochs over a broader collection of training files. This is a pipeline reproduction, not a convergence claim.

fullRun.estimateBasis: No defensible full-run estimate is available: the recorded step used a different checkpoint, a ten-example subset, one process, shorter sequences and one optimizer step, while the published standard example uses BGE-large, four data groups, two processes, 512-token limits and two epochs. Scaling the observed 27.3-second fine-tune would conflate all of those dimensions.
